spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (इ) इदि (इन्दति)
To have supreme power and superhuman faculties.

pron. mfn. (अयं इयं इदं)
This.
E.
इन्द to have power, कमिन् Uṇādi affix, and the radical न rejected.

f. (-र्य्या)
A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi?)
E.
इदम् this, and कार्य्य business; applied to this and that use.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Present, momentary, of the present moment.
E.
इदानीम् and द्यु aff.

ind.
1 Now, at present.
2 An expletive, affecting however slightly the sense.
E.
irr. deriv. from इदम् this, with दानीम् aff.

m. (-रः)
A year, one of the five sorts of years in which gifts of clothes and food are productive of great rewards.
